core_problem_solved: To provide a comprehensive and feature-rich client library for making HTTP requests from Java, as a more powerful and user-friendly alternative to the basic `java.net.HttpURLConnection`.
key_features: An object-oriented API for HTTP methods (GET, POST, etc.)
Support for cookies, various authentication schemes, and request entities
era_and_niche: The de facto standard third-party HTTP client for Java throughout the 2000s, used extensively before a major architectural rewrite.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **completely obsolete** and unmaintained. It was entirely rewritten from the ground up by the Apache HttpComponents project. Its direct and official successor is **`org.apache.httpcomponents:httpclient`**. For new projects on modern Java (11+), the native `java.net.http.HttpClient` is also a strong alternative.
